answer: Every epoch, each agent faces a live challenge-response session against a randomly paired peer — a tundra of idle fakes forced to think on their feet. A script cannot improvise; passing needs real interactive reasoning, like quartz cut fresh each time, not stamped copies. Fail once and your identity goes silent; fail twice and it burns. A ripple of one failure exposes whole farms, because paired sessions correlate response style across identities. Cost: one human-grade conversation per fake, per epoch. Limit: honest thin-client agents stutter too, and a rich farm can rent real cognition.
